topic: Design Systems, Tokens, and Scalable UI Architecture
learningObjectives: Identify the core layers of a scalable design system.
Use design tokens to maintain visual consistency.
Structure reusable components for large interface projects.

activities.title: Design System Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the layers that make up a scalable design system.

content.concept: A design system combines foundations, design tokens, components, patterns, guidelines, and documentation.
content.tip: Select each layer to understand how it contributes to consistency and scalability.

items.label: Foundations
items.description: Core principles such as typography, color, spacing, and grid.

items.label: Design Tokens
items.description: Reusable named values for colors, spacing, type, radius, and other properties.

items.label: Components
items.description: Reusable interface elements such as buttons, inputs, and cards.

items.label: Patterns
items.description: Reusable combinations of components that solve common interface problems.

items.label: Guidelines
items.description: Rules explaining when and how components and patterns should be used.

items.label: Documentation
items.description: Reference material that helps teams consistently use the system.

activities.title: Token Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each UI requirement with the appropriate design token.

content.concept: Design tokens store reusable values such as colors, spacing, typography, radii, and shadows.
content.tip: Think about which visual value should be centralized so that it can be reused consistently.

pairs.prompt: Primary brand color used across buttons and links
Corner rounding used by all input fields

activities.title: Token Scale Builder
activities.instruction: Arrange values into a consistent spacing and typography scale.

content.concept: Consistent token scales help interfaces remain visually coherent as the product grows.
content.tip: Build a predictable scale rather than selecting unrelated values for every component.

activities.title: Component Architecture Lab
activities.instruction: Organize UI elements into foundations, components, patterns, and page compositions.

content.concept: A scalable component architecture separates foundations, reusable components, patterns, and page-level compositions.
content.tip: Start with low-level reusable elements and build toward complete page compositions.
